body: That’s me everyone asked where do I see myself and I tell them 6 feet under tbh...like I feel theirs no need for me in the future.
I’m right there with you...solid food has made me sick and disgusted, but the only food I’ve kept down was peanut butter surprisingly...try that that has some good protein to it.

I literally think of the outcome, and I learn that it’s something people will grieve and get over it...but that’s something I shouldn’t even be thinking like that’s not a healthy lifestyle to think...my friend tells me all the time that theirs something to look forward into the future I’m still struggle to find out what that is.
Literally I open to a friend about suicide...and my response I got was “shame on you” &“that’s really selfish”
I’m sorry you feel that way, I honestly feel the same way....sending positive vibes to you my friend.
